notes: All four possessives sit on their genitive pronouns, leaving τό, τήν and ἡ unrepresented under rule 20; ὁ before Ἰωάννης is unrepresented under rule 23.
a leathern girdle follows rule 58: the supplied determiner belongs to the anarthrous noun, discontinuously under rule 15, and the adjective keeps a bare leathern.
SBLGNT.MAT.3.4.v003 leaves ἦν αὐτοῦ underdetermined but the projection's reading is fully translated, so no rule 97 question arises.
